name: Toolbelt Hotkeys & Control Enhancements
author: Trafficity Mod Manager
description: 1-9/0 toolbelt slots, wheel cycling + Ctrl+scroll zoom, Q toggle deletion, Shift+Del traffic eraser, context-aware E property shift, right-click idle pan, Shift+right-click delete, click-and-drag placement, Alt+1/2/3 speed, and Mouse Back/Forward Undo/Redo.

name: Redo Support
author: Trafficity Mod Manager
description: Adds a Redo stack on top of Trafficity's undo journal, provides the 'redo' service for other mods, and binds Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+Shift+Z.

name: Roundabout & Road Snap Lag Fix
author: Trafficity Mod Manager
description: Eliminates frame drops when connecting roads to roundabouts or autoconnecting by memoizing snap queries and bounding the 60-step midpoint overlap loop.

name: Measuring Grid & Snap Overlay
author: Trafficity Mod Manager
description: Togglable world measuring grid (Alt+G) calibrated to road step spacing (3u) and lane width (20u), with [ and ] granularity controls and optional Alt+S road-point snapping.

name: Eco-Scrubber Air Purifier
author: Trafficity Mod Manager
description: Adds a custom Eco-Scrubber Tower building with 2.5D procedural extrusions that actively cleans nearby air pollution around its plot.

name: Dev Console & Eval Bridge
author: Trafficity Mod Manager
description: Opt-in live external console log stream and interactive JS eval bridge for CLI, agents, and MCP tools. Disabled by default.

name: Dev Building Telemetry
author: Trafficity Mod Manager
description: Opt-in developer overlay in BuildingViewPanel showing exact satisfaction factors, targets, velocities, and color-coded progress bars. Disabled by default.

name: Manipulation Mod
author: artgey
description: Alt+M: cheats, vehicle reset, simulation speed, quiet asphalt, safer lane use, traffic light phases, lane signs and facility-linked service access.
